bigIdeas.en: Fractions and decimals are types of numbers that can represent quantities.
bigIdeas.zh: 分数和小数都是数，都可以用来表示数量。

bigIdeas.en: Development of computational fluency and multiplicative thinking requires analysis of patterns and relations in multiplication and division.
bigIdeas.zh: 运算的熟练和乘法思维，来自对乘除法中规律与关系的分析。

bigIdeas.en: Regular changes in patterns can be identified and represented using tools and tables.
bigIdeas.zh: 规律中固定的变化，可以用工具和表格找出来、表示出来。

bigIdeas.en: Polygons are closed shapes with similar attributes that can be described, measured, and compared.
bigIdeas.zh: 多边形是具有相似特征的封闭图形，可以描述、测量和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Analyzing and interpreting experiments in data probability develops an understanding of chance.
bigIdeas.zh: 通过做可能性实验、分析和解读数据，理解「机会」是怎么回事。

elaborations.en: counting: multiples; flexible counting strategies; whole number benchmarks
elaborations.zh: 数数：按倍数跳着数；灵活的数数策略；整数基准点（如 10、100、1000）

elaborations.en: Numbers to 10 000 can be arranged and recognized: comparing and ordering numbers; estimating large quantities
elaborations.zh: 10 000 以内的数可以排一排、认一认：比较和排序；估计大数量

elaborations.en: place value: 1000s, 100s, 10s, and 1s; understanding the relationship between digit places and their value, to 10 000
elaborations.zh: 数位：千位、百位、十位、个位；理解数位和位值的关系（到 10 000）

elaborations.en: Fractions and decimals are numbers that represent an amount or quantity.
elaborations.zh: 分数和小数都是表示数量的数。

elaborations.en: Fractions and decimals can represent parts of a region, set, or linear model.
elaborations.zh: 分数和小数可以表示一块区域、一组东西或一段长度的一部分。

elaborations.en: Fractional parts and decimals are equal shares or equal-sized portions of a whole or unit.
elaborations.zh: 分数和小数表示把整体（或单位）平均分之后的等份。

elaborations.en: understanding the relationship between fractions and decimals
elaborations.zh: 理解分数和小数之间的关系

elaborations.en: comparing and ordering of fractions with common denominators
elaborations.zh: 同分母分数的比较和排序

elaborations.en: estimating fractions with benchmarks (e.g., zero, half, whole)
elaborations.zh: 用基准点估计分数大小（如 0、一半、1）

elaborations.en: using concrete and visual models
elaborations.zh: 借助实物和图形模型

elaborations.en: equal partitioning
elaborations.zh: 平均分（等分）

elaborations.en: using flexible computation strategies, involving taking apart (e.g., decomposing using friendly numbers and compensating) and combining numbers in a variety of ways, regrouping
elaborations.zh: 用灵活的计算策略：拆数（比如凑成好算的数再补偿）、多种方式组合数、进位退位

elaborations.en: estimating sums and differences to 10 000
elaborations.zh: 估算 10 000 以内的和与差

elaborations.en: using addition and subtraction in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中用加减法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班数学漫谈（number talk：聊聊你是怎么算的）

items.en: multiplication and division of two- or three-digit numbers by one-digit numbers

elaborations.en: understanding the relationships between multiplication and division, multiplication and addition, division and subtraction
elaborations.zh: 理解乘法和除法、乘法和加法、除法和减法之间的关系

elaborations.en: using flexible computation strategies (e.g., decomposing, distributive principle, commutative principle, repeated addition and repeated subtraction)
elaborations.zh: 用灵活的计算策略（如拆数、分配律、交换律、连加和连减）

elaborations.en: using multiplication and division in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中用乘除法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班数学漫谈（number talk）

items.en: addition and subtraction of decimals to hundredths

elaborations.en: estimating decimal sums and differences
elaborations.zh: 估算小数的和与差

elaborations.en: using visual models, such as base 10 blocks, place-value mats, grid paper, and number lines
elaborations.zh: 借助图形模型：十进制积木、数位表、方格纸、数轴

elaborations.en: using addition and subtraction in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中用小数加减法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班数学漫谈（number talk）

items.en: addition and subtraction facts to 20 (developing computational fluency)

elaborations.en: Provide opportunities for authentic practice, building on previous grade-level addition and subtraction facts.
elaborations.zh: 在真实情境里多练习，巩固之前年级学过的加减法口算。

elaborations.en: flexible use of mental math strategies
elaborations.zh: 灵活运用心算策略

items.en: multiplication and division facts to 100 (introductory computational strategies)
items.zh: 100 以内乘除法口算（起步策略）

elaborations.en: Provide opportunities for concrete and pictorial representations of multiplication.
elaborations.zh: 多用实物和画图来表示乘法。

elaborations.en: building computational fluency
elaborations.zh: 逐步练出运算熟练度

elaborations.en: Use games to provide opportunities for authentic practice of multiplication computations.
elaborations.zh: 用游戏来真实地练乘法。

elaborations.en: looking for patterns in numbers, such as in a hundred chart, to further develop understanding of multiplication computation
elaborations.zh: 在百数表等地方找数的规律，加深对乘法的理解

elaborations.en: Connect multiplication to skip-counting.
elaborations.zh: 把乘法和跳着数联系起来。

elaborations.en: Connecting multiplication to division and repeated addition.
elaborations.zh: 把乘法和除法、连加联系起来。

elaborations.en: Memorization of facts is not intended for this level.
elaborations.zh: 这个阶段不要求死记硬背。

elaborations.en: Students will become more fluent with these facts.
elaborations.zh: 孩子会在练习中越来越熟。

elaborations.en: using mental math strategies, such as doubling or halving
elaborations.zh: 用翻倍、减半等心算策略

elaborations.en: Students should be able to recall the following multiplication facts by the end of Grade 4 (2s, 5s, 10s).
elaborations.zh: 四年级结束时，2、5、10 的乘法口算应能脱口而出。

items.en: increasing and decreasing patterns, using tables and charts
items.zh: 递增和递减的规律（用表格和图表）

elaborations.en: Change in patterns can be represented in charts, graphs, and tables.
elaborations.zh: 规律的变化可以用图表、统计图和表格表示出来。

elaborations.en: using words and numbers to describe increasing and decreasing patterns
elaborations.zh: 用语言和数字描述递增、递减的规律

elaborations.en: fish stocks in lakes, life expectancies
elaborations.zh: 生活例子：湖里鱼群数量的变化、人的预期寿命

elaborations.en: representing and explaining one-step equations with an unknown number
elaborations.zh: 表示并解释含未知数的一步方程

elaborations.en: describing pattern rules, using words and numbers from concrete and pictorial representations
elaborations.zh: 从实物和图形出发，用语言和数字描述规律的法则

elaborations.en: planning a camping or hiking trip; planning for quantities and materials needed per individual and group over time
elaborations.zh: 生活例子：计划露营或远足，按人数和天数算需要多少物资

items.en: one-step equations with an unknown number, using all operations
items.zh: 一步方程（含未知数，加减乘除）

elaborations.en: one-step equations for all operations involving an unknown number (e.g., ___ + 4 = 15, 15 – □ = 11)
elaborations.zh: 四种运算的一步方程，含一个未知数（如 ___ + 4 = 15，15 − □ = 11）

elaborations.en: start unknown (e.g., n + 15 = 20; 20 – 15 = □)
change unknown (e.g., 12 + n = 20)
elaborations.zh: 变化量未知（如 12 + n = 20）

elaborations.en: result unknown (e.g., 6 + 13 = __)

items.en: how to tell time with analog and digital clocks, using 12- and 24-hour clocks
items.zh: 认识钟表：12 时和 24 时计时法

elaborations.en: understanding how to tell time with analog and digital clocks, using 12- and 24-hour clocks
elaborations.zh: 会看指针钟和电子钟，会用 12 时和 24 时计时法

elaborations.en: understanding the concept of a.m. and p.m.
elaborations.zh: 理解上午（a.m.）和下午（p.m.）

elaborations.en: understanding the number of minutes in an hour
elaborations.zh: 知道 1 小时有多少分钟

elaborations.en: understanding the concepts of using a circle and of using fractions in telling time (e.g., half past, quarter to)
elaborations.zh: 用圆和分数理解时间（如 half past「半点」、quarter to「差一刻」）

elaborations.en: telling time in five-minute intervals
elaborations.zh: 按 5 分钟一格读时间

elaborations.en: telling time to the nearest minute
elaborations.zh: 读到最接近的分钟

elaborations.en: First Peoples use of numbers in time and seasons, represented by seasonal cycles and moon cycles (e.g., how position of sun, moon, and stars is used to determine times for traditional activities, navigation)
elaborations.zh: 原住民（First Peoples）用季节周期和月相周期看时间（如根据日月星辰的位置安排传统活动、导航）

items.zh: 规则多边形和不规则多边形

elaborations.en: describing and sorting regular and irregular polygons based on multiple attributes
elaborations.zh: 按多种特征描述和分类规则、不规则多边形

elaborations.en: investigating polygons (polygons are closed shapes with similar attributes)
elaborations.zh: 研究多边形（多边形是具有相似特征的封闭图形）

elaborations.en: Yup’ik border patterns
elaborations.zh: 尤皮克（Yup'ik）原住民的花边图案

items.teachHints: shapeRect、shapeTriangle（其他多边形可用 caption 文字说明）

items.en: perimeter of regular and irregular shapes
items.zh: 图形的周长（规则与不规则）

elaborations.en: using geoboards and grids to create, represent, measure, and calculate perimeter
elaborations.zh: 用钉板和方格纸摆一摆、画一画、量一量、算一算周长

elaborations.en: using concrete materials such as pattern blocks to create designs that have a mirror image within them
elaborations.zh: 用图形积木等实物拼出带镜像的对称图案

elaborations.en: First Peoples art, borders, birchbark biting, canoe building
elaborations.zh: 原住民艺术中的对称：花边、桦树皮咬画、独木舟制作

elaborations.en: Visit a structure designed by First Peoples in the local community and have the students examine the symmetry, balance, and patterns within the structure, then replicate simple models of the architecture focusing on the patterns they noted in the original.
elaborations.zh: 参观本地原住民设计的建筑，观察其中的对称、平衡和图案，再动手仿建小模型。

items.teachHints: shapeRect（对称轴用 caption 文字说明）

items.en: one-to-one correspondence and many-to-one correspondence, using bar graphs and pictographs
items.zh: 条形统计图和象形统计图（一对一与多对一）

elaborations.en: many-to-one correspondence: one symbol represents a group or value (e.g., on a bar graph, one square may represent five cookies)
elaborations.zh: 多对一：一个符号代表一组数量（如条形图上一格代表 5 块饼干）

elaborations.en: predicting single outcomes (e.g., when you spin using one spinner and it lands on a single colour)
elaborations.zh: 预测单次结果（如转一次转盘，指针会停在哪种颜色）

elaborations.en: using spinners, rolling dice, pulling objects out of a bag
elaborations.zh: 转转盘、掷骰子、从袋子里摸东西

elaborations.en: recording results using tallies
elaborations.zh: 用画「正」字的方式（tally）记录结果

elaborations.en: Dene/Kaska hand games, Lahal stick games
elaborations.zh: 原住民游戏：Dene/Kaska 手游戏、Lahal 棍棒游戏

items.en: financial literacy — monetary calculations, including making change with amounts to 100 dollars and making simple financial decisions
items.zh: 钱的计算与简单理财（100 元以内找零）

elaborations.en: making monetary calculations, including decimal notation in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中算钱，会用小数记法（如 $3.25）

elaborations.en: applying a variety of strategies, such as counting up, counting back, and decomposing, to calculate totals and make change
elaborations.zh: 用往上数、往回数、拆数等多种策略算总价和找零

elaborations.en: making simple financial decisions involving earning, spending, saving, and giving
elaborations.zh: 做简单的理财决定：挣钱、花钱、存钱、捐助

elaborations.en: equitable trade rules
elaborations.zh: 公平交易规则
